purpose: One Static Collective garden of independently owned organs. Make work resumable across chats, machines, private/public repositories, and discontinuities without relying on a README, chat memory, or a universal authority database.

foundations.text: GHoT units of work are offers, tasks, execution attempts, and attributable receipts. Capability and planning are not execution or authority.
The Collective is one garden, not a collection of products; select the relevant owning organ for a task. Do not preload every repository or create a new master canon.

Authenticated repository discovery includes private repos by default when access exists. Do not publish private content or names to a public index; a public-only inventory must declare its coverage boundary.

AGENTS.md is the operating protocol, owner-written intent and source links hold foundations, and CONTINUE.md is generated. README is optional historical/onboarding material, not current operational authority.
Proposed, merged, deployed, field-tested, and user-corrected are different states. Never manufacture a test result or erase an earlier cut.

next: After owner review, merge and trigger the garden-pulse workflow. Prove an unchanged check makes no new commit, then exercise a PR status change and fresh-chat re-entry. Extend the workflow to HUMKIN and one authorized private pilot without copying their facts into this public repo.
unknowns: No automatic cross-project credentials or privileged writer has been installed.
Scheduled GitHub Actions are best-effort; future-chat connector retrieval still needs a deliberate entry protocol.
No end-to-end blind re-entry or external device test has been executed.
